text:
ashley: quick sync: proposing a "surface contract" for launch — want to lock the MVP surface so eng can optimize latency. rough idea below.

ashley: ```
MVP surface:
- chat generate (single-turn + short context)
- embeddings (search-lite)
- no multi-tool flows

Launch criteria:
- p50_gen <= 250ms
- p95_gen <= 800ms
- cost per 1k tokens <= $0.02
- pilot for 5 tenants
```

sam: ok re: latency. we can hit p50 on a quantized 7B with optimized KV cache, but p95 needs fewer model variants and aggressive batching.

kim: sounds reasonable. question: can we drop the persona prompt + system weights to save ~7% latency? :thinking: 

sam: dropping persona helps. also suggest single model serving path for MVP (no dynamic routing). fallback -> hosted 7B for spikes.

noah: capacity note — single-serving-path reduces complexity but we need to reserve burst capacity on Dedicated. if we want p95 < 700ms for traffic pattern X, add 2 weeks to infra work.

esme: from sales — customers expect SSO + audit logs at GA. can we make SSO optional for pilot? important for conversion.

ashley: propose phased rollout:
1) MVP pilot (opt-in tenants) w/ single-model path + optional SSO via feature flag
2) canary (10% traffic) with fallback to hosted during spikes
3) GA when metrics stable for 7 days

ashley: action items: @sam validate p50/p95 on perf harness by EOD Tue, @noah surface infra reserve cost impact, @kim confirm what UX to trim.

release-bot: canary created for project/redwood-mvp — rolling to 2 hosts

sam: I'll post perf numbers to #benchmarks once done.

kim: approve plan from product side. keep me looped on any +2 week timeline impacts.

ashley: thanks all — I'll update the roadmap doc and send the pilot invite list later today.
